provenance.auth: None required. A free key raises limits from 25 to 500 requests a day.
provenance.cadence: Monthly. CPI around the 12th, employment the first Friday.
provenance.reliability: Primary source. The number the market trades.
provenance.caveat: Observations are stamped with the REFERENCE month, not the release date. July data carries 2026-07-01 but does not publish until mid-August, so a current print always looks 40 to 60 days old here. Prior months get revised, sometimes heavily.
provenance.lag_note: This source publishes about 14 days behind real time, so an observation that old is normal, not a broken feed. For same-session crude you would need a front-month futures feed, which is licensed.
provenance.quality_meaning: Fetched from the originating source. This is a real observation.

move.detail: +10 bp. Bigger in magnitude than 64% of the 55 moves since 2022-02-01. The typical move is 8.7 bp; this is 0.9 sigma.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the bottom of its 1-year range, at the 18th percentile.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates DOWN. A fall pushes them UP.

chains.chain: Unemployment rate → ↑ Recession risk → ↓ 10Y Treasury → ↓ MBS yield → ↓ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: Recession fear is the classic bid for duration. Yields fall.
MBS are priced off the Treasury curve. This is the main channel.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.

chains.chain: Unemployment rate → ↓ Fed policy stance → ↓ 2Y Treasury → ↓ 10Y Treasury → ↓ MBS yield → ↓ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: The employment half of the dual mandate.
The front end prices the expected path of policy.
Front-end repricing pulls the belly and the long end, but only partly.
MBS are priced off the Treasury curve. This is the main channel.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.

chains.chain: Unemployment rate → ↓ Fed policy stance → ↓ QT / MBS runoff → ↓ MBS spread → ↓ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: The employment half of the dual mandate.
A hawkish Fed keeps runoff going.
Fed MBS runoff removes the largest price-insensitive buyer from the market.
A wider spread raises the borrower rate even when Treasuries are unchanged.
